summary.valueString: Sofia Navarro, owner and driver of the 2019 Toyota Corolla LE, reported that on 09/23/2025 around 6:07 PM, while it was raining, she was entering the curved entrance on Lakebend Drive in Palmetto Bayview when the right-front wheel hit the curb at the edge of the road. She reported the steering pulled to the right, the wheel and tire felt unsafe, she stopped driving, pulled over, called for a tow, and had the vehicle taken to a local repair shop for inspection. She stated no other vehicle was involved and no one was hurt, and that she reported the incident to insurance on 09/24/2025.
